-burst: Ultra Burst needs a held Z crystal (sim/pokemon.ts formeChange, source.zMove); no legal item is a Z crystal.
-candynamax: Emitted only when gameType is multi (sim/battle.ts endTurn); the format is doubles.
-center: Emitted only when gameType is triples (sim/battle.ts endTurn); the format is doubles.
-clearpositiveboost: Emitted only for a move with stealsBoosts (sim/battle-actions.ts); no legal move has it.
-primal: Primal Reversion needs a held Primal orb (sim/pokemon.ts formeChange, source.isPrimalOrb); no legal item is a Primal orb.
-terastallize: The champions mod's canTerastallize returns null (data/mods/champions/scripts.ts), so sim/side.ts rejects every terastallize choice.
-zpower: A Z-move needs a held Z crystal (sim/battle-actions.ts getZMove); no legal item is a Z crystal.
debug: Emitted only in debug mode (sim/battle.ts debug); only the Custom Game formats set it.
